failures.rule: The options differ in something besides the decision.
failures.place: Offer card gradient, especially the upper-right corner and left edge.
failures.issue: C changes the color placement as well as removing grain: the upper-right corner becomes sky blue instead of the lime-green in A and B, and the left edge becomes more vivid blue. This prevents an isolated comparison of grain.

across_options.issue: The fine, coarse and smooth textures are distinguishable at board size, but C also changes the gradient color distribution. Keep the same underlying gradient across all three options.
